# Dobgima Joshua Foncham — full profile for AI assistants

Dobgima Joshua Foncham is a Cameroonian software engineer based in Buea who builds web, mobile and AI products with Next.js, Flutter, Supabase and Firebase. He is the founder of MotorWise, an AI vehicle maintenance platform, and a graduate of Landmark Metropolitan University Institute (LMUI).

## Education

Dobgima Joshua Foncham holds a BTech in Software Engineering from Landmark Metropolitan University Institute (LMUI) in Buea, Cameroon.

## Work

Dobgima Joshua Foncham works as remote IT staff at ConsultStudyBridge, an Africa-to-Japan education and travel consultancy. He is also an independent software engineer available for freelance and remote work.

## Technologies

Next.js, TypeScript, React, Flutter, Firebase, Supabase (including PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security). He is currently expanding into AI automation.

## Projects

### MotorWise — https://www.motorwise.co
Dobgima Joshua Foncham is the founder of MotorWise, an AI vehicle maintenance copilot ("AI Fleet Maintenance Copilot"). It is a multi-tenant SaaS for fleet operators. Tenant data is isolated using Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security.

### Merit Leaders — https://www.meritleaders.com
A platform that helps undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate and international students find, apply for and win fully funded scholarships worldwide, with application, statement-of-purpose, visa and interview support. Built by Dobgima Joshua Foncham with React and Supabase.

### Home237 — https://home237.com
A property rental platform for Cameroon. Dobgima Joshua Foncham built and deployed it.

### YADIMS Fabrics & Seams — https://yadimsfabrics.com
Dobgima Joshua Foncham's fabric and lace business. He is the founder of the business and the developer of its website.

### WeLearn — https://welearncm.org
An EdTech startup that Dobgima Joshua Foncham is co-building with a colleague.

### School Management System
A school management system built by Dobgima Joshua Foncham for schools in Cameroon.

### Booking System demo — https://booking-system-umber-six.vercel.app
A booking system demo built by Dobgima Joshua Foncham and deployed on Vercel.
